matcher_notes: All phrases match case-insensitively as substrings of the incoming client message after lowercasing. Phrases are stored lowercase. Word-boundary risk is low because phrases are multi-word and specific. Regex flexibility deferred to v2 (see voice/decisions.html dec-031).
scoring_notes: Severity controls badge color in the popup. low = ambient watch, medium = likely scope-expansion, high = clear unbilled-work ask. The matcher sums severities for the per-message score; messages with combined score >= 2 should be flagged prominently.
